description: Utility class HexUtil for converting between bytes and hexadecimal strings, including methods for hex string parsing, formatting, and byte array manipulation.

classes.name: HexUtil
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods for hex and byte conversions.

methods.name: asHex
methods.description: Converts a byte or byte array to a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: asBytes
methods.description: Converts a hex string to a byte array, handling optional '0x' prefix and spaces.

methods.name: bytesToHex
methods.description: Converts a subset of a byte array to a hex string.

methods.name: bytesToHexAppend
methods.description: Appends hex representation of bytes to a StringBuffer.

methods.name: hexToBytes
methods.description: Converts a hex string to a byte array, with optional offset.

methods.name: hexToInt
methods.description: Parses a hex string to an integer, handling optional '0x' prefix.

methods.name: intToHexString
methods.description: Converts an integer to a hex string with '0x' prefix.
